emissionRule: every emitted light must have an explicit loaded source; reflection is never promoted to emission

materialResponseRules.soft_matte_cloth: broad low-intensity reflection; no glossy specular
materialResponseRules.worn_metal: small source-shaped highlights; no automatic gold shift
materialResponseRules.skin: preserve canonical/local skin tone and texture; avoid porcelain normalization
materialResponseRules.hair_fur: source-dependent edge response; no neon outline
materialResponseRules.robot_shell_panel: material-based response; indicator light only when source-backed

backgroundRules.transparent_reference: no scenic background; restrained neutral/world-credible light for design inspection
backgroundRules.scene_or_cutin: environment may cast local light but cannot recolor identity or invent costume-side emission
backgroundRules.silhouette_separation: use value/background separation before rim-light tricks
backgroundRules.atmosphere: fog/bloom/bokeh may support depth but cannot hide anatomy, garment construction, or prop relation

nonHumanRules.DOG: fur reflects local source; magical eye glow prohibited unless explicitly sourced
nonHumanRules.CAT: fur reflects local source; magical eye glow prohibited unless explicitly sourced
nonHumanRules.ARTIFICIAL_PERSON: artificiality does not authorize neon seams, glowing eyes, or robot shorthand
nonHumanRules.MAINTENANCE_ROBOT: shell/panel response follows material; indicators/tools emit only when source-backed
